name: Black Stanley 40 Oz Stainless Steel Tumbler | Leak-Proof Vacuum Insulated Travel Mug | Hot & Cold
description:
Stay refreshed all day with the Stanley 40 Oz (1200ML) Black Stainless Steel Tumbler, designed to keep drinks hot or ice-cold for hours. Made with rust-resistant stainless steel and advanced vacuum insulation, this tumbler ensures long-lasting freshness and durability. Its leak-proof lid with straw allows for mess-free sipping, while the ergonomic handle makes it perfect for gym, travel, commuting, or outdoor adventures. A wide-mouth design allows for quick refills and easy cleaning.
Key Features
 40 Oz (1200ML) large capacity for all-day hydration
 Advanced vacuum insulation keeps drinks hot & cold for hours
 Leak-proof lid with straw for convenient sipping
 Rust-resistant stainless steel for durability
 Ergonomic handle for carrying anywhere
 Wide-mouth opening for refills and cleaning
How to Use
 Fill tumbler with your favorite hot or cold beverage
 Secure the leak-proof lid and straw before use
 Carry with ergonomic handle for on-the-go hydration
 Hand wash or use gentle cleaning for long-lasting quality
Material
Rust-Resistant Stainless Steel, BPA-Free Plastic Lid, Silicone Seal
Safety Information
 Do not microwave or freeze
 Ensure lid is tightly secured to avoid spills
 Handle with care when filled with hot liquids
 Keep away from children if beverage is hot
Package Includes
 1 × Stanley 40 Oz (1200ML) Black Stainless Steel Tumbler with Lid & Straw
